name: Ma trận tương đồng mảnh

parameters: Analysis type: pixel, Media: image, Confidence threshold: adaptive
accuracy: Moderate to High — 65-85% standalone, higher when combined with other methods

strengths:
• Effective pixel analysis technique

limitations:
